name: Show Stage Run activity in the Board TUI
description:
Factory review recommendation 18 of 20.

## Context

The Software Factory Plugin does not provide a card badge even though the Plugin API supports one.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add Board badges for running and failed Stage Runs, including attempt where useful.
- Provide an inspectable Stage Run view with worker identity, outcome and activity age.
- Follow the TUI design system and verify the screens with agentic-tui captures.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor review: Plan accepted. Use shared DetailView and per-component PascalCase file, existing tokens, and plain badge text; no new hue/core shell redesign. The Stage Run tab is read-only so no creation key. Use useReloadOnReturn without hiding loaded rows or gating keys during a reload; no-Run empty view is accurate under ADR0040 (do not retain prior visits/history). Label elapsed/relative age from existing timestamps honestly; if displayed as live, use a bounded cleaned-up refresh/shared ticker, not a watcher/server. Current worker string is sufficient now; ROW49 sidecar identity contract is being coordinated, no dependency or invented heartbeat fields. Export relativeDate narrowly with API docs; keep TS/TSX documentation blocks sourced from compiled fixtures if added. Badges use currentRun with no extra I/O; existing ADR0028 permits file-loaded badges but you do not need it here. Agentic-tui evidence as proposed including narrow view/long worker id legibility and failed reason. No new tests for cosmetic changes; run all four checks. Proceed.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/142 shows Stage Run activity in the Board TUI. Board cards and list lines get a plain-text badge for a running or failed Stage Run in the current visit (▶ running, ✕ failed #2), and a read-only Stage Run Story tab shows outcome, attempt, worker, who started it, start and end times with their age, elapsed time and failure reason, with live ages refreshed on a bounded timer while running. relativeDate is now exported to Plugins, and the docs and skills are updated. Typecheck and lint passed; 78 unit and 20 CLI tests passed. Agentic-tui screenshots at 140 and 80 columns are uploaded and return 200.
